values./system/description:
Combat shotguns are shotguns intended for an offensive role, typically by a military force; they’re ideal for close-range fighting in tunnels, within buildings, or through the ruined streets of old cities.

A Combat Shotgun can accept one each of the following mods:

  • Receiver: Calibrated, Hardened, Automatic, Hair Trigger, Powerful, Advanced
  • Barrel: Long Barrel, Ported Barrel
  • Stock: Full Stock, Marksman’s Stock, RecoilCompensating Stock
  • Magazine: Large Magazine, Quick-Eject Magazine, Large Quick-Eject Magazine
  • Sights: Reflex Sight, Short Scope, Long Scope, Short Night Vision Scope, Long Night Vision Scope, Recon Scope
  • Muzzle: Bayonet, Compensator, Muzzle Brake, Suppressor
